verdict.rationale: Autumn publishes a structured API reference with per-endpoint pages (attach, track, previewAttach, openCustomerPortal, multiAttach, createSchedule, import, attachLicense) and code examples such as `autumn.check` and `autumn.track`. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in the browser, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: an interactive try-it/playground in the API reference, runnable in-browser examples, a published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
